description: This file defines the main HomeScreen widget for the Flutter app, incorporating tab navigation for different news categories, a drawer with navigation options, and interaction with the app state.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that provides the main interface with tabs representing different news categories, app bar actions, and a drawer.

classes.name: _CategoryTabSpec
classes.description: A helper class to specify the title and widget for each news category tab.

classes.name: _HomeDrawer
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that constructs the navigation drawer with links to Settings and Saved News.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method of HomeScreen that constructs the widget tree, including AppBar, TabBar, TabBarView, and error message display.
